scope: Stock Phase A G2/G4 boundary characterization; upstream clients only, NOT adapter runtime validation or signoff
observations: The safe integer 2^53-1 round-trips; the native client preserves 9007199254740993n while the Supabase JS decoder returns 9007199254740992 despite the exact JSON integer on the wire.
On the declared text fixture, `.eq('note', null)` selects the literal string `null`, not SQL NULL, in both installed clients.
Nonfinite/fractional numeric filters, typo fields and malformed UUID filters return errors rather than broadening reads.

Native ascending nullable ordering puts NULL first; reference default ordering puts it last. ASCII/binary and Unicode ordering observations remain backend-specific outside the approved portable text-sort domain.

Reference query construction is lazy; each await sends again; independent builders isolate, while the same builder and captured options remain mutable. Native list operations likewise issue a new request on each query and observe mutation of shared options.
explicitNonClaims: No production codec, runtime validation, query builder, or null-normalization implementation.
No Unicode/collation parity or nullable ordering guarantee.
